posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked:
I talked with Paul about this yesterday, and I wanted to come in here and give you the final word on this topic of conversation.

10 PRINT The Villain foil pack will not be including cards that are not currently in the Oversized Villain Pack. 

20 GOTO 10

We introduced this pack because it was a special thing we could do for this Kickstarter that would also not increase production time. We would not want to add the Vengeance, VotM, or OblivAeon Villains cards without also doing new art for them, and that means more time spent drawing for Adam.

And that's pretty much the final word.
